title: Diagnose seed leverage mismatch
commands_run: read-only DB inspection of data\mexc.sqlite action_queue action_id=13
read-only api_executor normalize_action reconstruction for action_id=13
rg leverage/seed leverage code path inspection

failed_action.error_message: Order leverage is inconsistent with the existing position leverage

leverage_sources.api_executor_default: none; requires action leverage and only caps by max leverage

cause.explanation: The protected seed action payload is created with hardcoded leverage=50 in automation_read_only_runner._build_seed_submit_action_payload. api_executor preserves that action leverage, caps only above contract max leverage, and MEXC rejected the OPEN_LONG post-only LIMIT because existing SOL positions use 300x leverage.

source_priority: current live position leverage for the symbol/side if any position exists
supervised strategy default leverage if added/available
block with seed_leverage_unknown if ambiguous or unavailable
when_to_block: no position leverage and no explicit seed_leverage/default
long/short position leverage mismatch for the same symbol
resolved leverage is missing, zero, or not parseable

summary: Read-only diagnosis of failed SOL seed action 13 found a leverage mismatch: the seed action was written with leverage=50, while live SOL LONG and SHORT positions are 300x cross. api_executor did not invent the value; it came from the runner's seed submit payload. Recommended fix is a read-only seed leverage resolver and preflight block if leverage cannot be safely resolved.
